title: feat(ridk7): ridge-slide same-k holds at k=7: t=19 vs t=25
science: Introduces the band's winning rule: ridge-slide rho3 = mu + cost 3 on a 3->3 hop whose destination has EXACTLY TWO unit coordinates. At k=7 on B_21: t=19 vs 25, 1083>625. The two witness walks are the load-bearing content -- the axis route stays at support 2 on a height-2 corridor (3+1+3+6+3+3=19, giving intercept +12) while the body route climbs inside a face plane and enters the body only at the end (3+1+3+11+1+6=25, giving 3k+4). That asymmetry is the whole mechanism of the band.
